From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Trevor Holt <trevor.holt@orbitapps.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action required: OrbitApps pricing gate + forecast cleanup

Team — quick heads up on ORB-4921 (OrbitApps). Finance ran the weekly forecast extract and this deal is still staged as "Commit" in HubSpot at the pre-discount value. We have a 25% discount request in-thread with procurement; Deal Desk approval hasn’t landed into the record yet.

Why this matters: Finance will count committed ARR at the contract (post-discount) value for the May close. If the Deal Desk decision is delayed, our forecast will be overstated for the quarter and we’ll have to pull corrections in the next week (not ideal).

Asks (short):
- Karthik: please confirm discount approval or escalation path by EOD tomorrow (2027-05-21 17:00 PT).
- Vanessa: update the HubSpot stage to "Commit - pending paperwork" and add a note with the approved concession % once received.
- Marcus/Laura (Finance): take the attached forecast export and flag any other deals that have stage/value mismatches by tomorrow morning.

I’ve attached the forecast_standings_export_20270520.csv so you can cross-check. If we get formal approval from Deal Desk before EOD, we will keep this as committed (with post-discount ARR). If not, please mark it as "Commit - at risk" for the week.

Thanks — keeping this tight to avoid last-minute adjustments.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

I’ll update HubSpot stage to "Commit - pending paperwork" now and drop a note with the procurement email thread. If Karthik can confirm approval % today or tomorrow morning, I’ll change it to the final committed status and attach the concession doc.

Vanessa / Priya — after reviewing the OrbitApps request and the strategic account guidelines, Deal Desk will approve a 22% concession on the subscription price under the following conditions:

1) Signed amendment to the MSA or an addendum that explicitly states the 22% concession and a 12-month minimum term.
2) Customer agrees to net-30 payment terms (no special invoicing cadence).
3) Sales to confirm the final list of SKUs included in the concession; concessions apply only to core inference consumption fees, not professional services.

I’ve attached the concession memo (OrbitApps_discount_concession_20270520.pdf) — use that to update HubSpot and attach to the deal record. Once the DocuSign is completed and the amendment is uploaded, Finance can count the post-discount ARR in the May committed bucket.

Linking the deal in HubSpot for reference: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/ORB-4921
